prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1038; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured driver. Side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle entered on a red signal and struck the driver's side. No police report number yet. Vehicle is drivable but towed from scene per insured. Assigned to field adjuster for inspection.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports neck and back strain following the collision and has been seeing a primary care provider. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and has not retained counsel. Explained the claims process and requested medical records authorization. Claimant agreed to send forms.

Entry 3: Photos of both vehicles received from the insured. Damage consistent with a side impact on the driver's door and rear quarter panel of the insured vehicle. Estimate requested from the preferred repair facility. Independent appraisal scheduled for next available slot.

Entry 4: Reviewed traffic camera footage from the intersection with the municipal office. Footage shows the other vehicle proceeding through a red signal. Liability position strengthened toward the other driver. Subrogation file opened against the at-fault carrier.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. Neck and back symptoms ongoing, claimant reports reduced range of motion and missed some work shifts. Reminded claimant of the option to seek independent advice. Medical bills and wage documentation requested. File remains open pending records and repair estimate.
